scope: Independent visual and source-use review of CAST-01 generation-002, CAST-02 generation-002, CAST-03 generation-002, and CAST-04 generations-001 through -003. The six declared source PNGs were opened with view_image. CAST-01 alpha geometry, CAST-02 two-view composition, CAST-03 phone layout, CAST-04 operating-state copy, text legibility, unwanted values or logos, and brand consistency were reviewed. No source, prompt, registry, or generated image was edited.

relevant_rules: The Climb — by AI Ascension is the series identity.
The visual language is paper, ink, amber, clear charts, branching paths, and restrained editorial typography.
Generated artwork is a visual companion and not product or gameplay evidence.
Use approved generated identity exports when available; generated lettering or an unverified embedded mark is not a runtime brand authorization.

checks: Compared each viewed source with its exact root prompt and the matching CAST registry brief.
Verified all six source hashes, dimensions, and modes against the three supplied generation receipts.
Inspected CAST-01 alpha values by region. The principal left gameplay opening has no alpha at compositing strength; only sub-128 antialiasing occurs at the panel and lower rule boundaries.
Inspected text at the native source dimensions and the intended aspect composition. No OCR or functional broadcast-host test was substituted for visual inspection.
Compared palette, path treatment, typography hierarchy, attribution, and embedded marks with the final brand guide and approved identity references.
Looked for game screenshots, real footage, fabricated metrics, provider or publisher logos, dates, timers, live badges, and other invented values.
not_tested: No live or recorded broadcast host was run.
No dynamic field population was tested.
CAST-03 was not composited with actual game footage; its footage crop and safe area remain untested.
No mechanical export or final consumer integration was approved by this review.

source_blockers_or_conditions: CAST-02 and CAST-04 generations-002/-003 contain unverified A-like embedded monograms that do not match the approved ID-01/ID-04 identity exports; root must decide whether to regenerate without them or establish an exact approved-mark route.
CAST-03 needs a real-footage crop/composite check before approval, and its eight empty Human intervention cells introduce unspecified meter-like semantics.
CAST-04 generation-001 is clean; the generation-002/-003 footer mark treatment is inconsistent with that clean variant and with the approved identity export.
summary.overall_visual_result: The six sources share a strong near-black, warm-ivory, amber-path editorial language. Text and state copy are legible at source dimensions, and no fabricated run values or gameplay evidence are visible. The marked conditions prevent a blanket source approval for every variant.
summary.decision: Bounded source review complete. CAST-01 and CAST-04 generation-001 are source-ready for a separate mechanical-export check. CAST-02, CAST-03, and CAST-04 generations-002/-003 remain conditional as recorded. This is not a broadcast-host, deployment, publication, legal, trademark, or public-release approval.

assets.title: Single-agent broadcast overlay
observations: The large left gameplay opening is genuinely transparent in the source. At alpha >= 128, the opening above the lower bar is empty; the only faint nonzero pixels there are sub-128 antialiasing at the panel and lower rule boundaries.

The right status panel is opaque and contains The Climb, TEMPLATE · NO LIVE DATA, and blank Model config, Floor, Health, Status, Action, Public explanation, and Human intervention fields. No values, game scene, provider logo, controller icon, or result are embedded.

The source visually divides at approximately 74% opening and 26% panel, close to the requested 76%/24% relationship while preserving game-dominant space. The panel labels are readable at source size; long live values remain an untested consumer concern.
The footer reads AI Ascension and has no separate invented monogram. The near-black, warm-ivory, amber, path-line, and restrained editorial treatment is consistent with the brand guide.
assets.source_use_observation: No declared external reference is present in the supplied receipt. No third-party mark, provider or publisher logo, proprietary game image, gameplay capture, or fabricated value was observed.
assets.broadcast_host_boundary: The transparent opening is a source-design observation only. It does not prove that a browser source, OBS scene, stream-status signal, dynamic field renderer, or real game feed works end to end.
limits: The exact target export dimensions and transparent compositing behavior require a separate mechanical-export and consumer check.
The bottom bar is intentionally opaque across the opening and must remain separate from the alpha-opening claim.

assets.title: Comparison broadcast overlay
observations: The source has exactly two equally large, empty outlined footage panels, labeled View A and View B, with a readable blank Model config line beneath each. It does not invent a third or fourth stream.

The bottom fields Conditions, Human intervention, and Public commentary are separated and blank. The title Comparison view and TEMPLATE · NO LIVE DATA are legible, with no scores, names, model values, game imagery, or claims.
The path ornament and amber/ivory/charcoal treatment fit the Ascent Ledger language.

issues.finding: The far-left path ornament contains a clear A-like monogram inside a ring, and the footer repeats a separate outlined A-like mark beside AI ASCENSION. These marks are not the approved ID-01 branching-A export and were not requested as a logo in the prompt.
issues.required_follow_up: Root should regenerate with the ornament-only treatment or use a separately verified approved identity export through the permitted route. Do not paint, trace, or mechanically redraw the mark in this review.

assets.source_use_observation: No declared external reference is present in the supplied receipt. No third-party or provider mark, gameplay capture, or fabricated value was observed; the concern is the unverified generated monogram as a first-party brand-boundary issue.
assets.broadcast_host_boundary: The two-panel composition does not establish synchronized feeds, matching comparison conditions, model configuration population, or actual broadcast operation.

assets.title: Mobile broadcast layout
observations: The portrait source has a large empty outlined Game view, a separate empty Subtitle area, a bottom Model/Floor/Status strip, and a Human intervention row. The dark interior is a reserved blank area, not a fabricated game scene.

The title The Climb, TEMPLATE · NO LIVE DATA, Game view, Subtitle area, Model, Floor, Status, and Human intervention are readable at the native source dimensions. No values, logos, gameplay capture, or performance claim is visible.

The eight empty cells in the Human intervention row carry no values, but they can read as an eight-step indicator rather than a free-form empty field. This is a source-design ambiguity to resolve before using that row for arbitrary intervention text.

The source uses the dark/ivory/amber path language consistently, but it has no visible by AI Ascension or AI Ascension attribution. The consuming surface must supply the series attribution or root must add it through a new creative generation if the image is expected to stand alone.

issues.finding: The requested actual-footage crop/composite was not performed. Safe areas, aspect fit, letterboxing, subtitle collision, and readability with a real game frame remain unverified.
issues.required_follow_up: Composite an approved real footage frame through the intended 1080x1920 consumer path and inspect the crop before marking the mobile export ready.

issues.finding: Eight empty Human intervention cells are an unrequested meter-like affordance and may imply a fixed count or control.
issues.required_follow_up: Confirm that the consumer intentionally uses eight slots, or obtain a new creative revision with one unambiguous empty row.

issues.finding: The standalone source names The Climb but does not visibly identify AI Ascension.
issues.required_follow_up: Keep an adjacent full series attribution in the consuming surface, or regenerate a self-identifying title treatment.
